title: Ten Cups of Coffee
hook: What if you drink ten coffees a day?
banner:
WHAT IF YOU SIP
TEN COFFEES?

beats.label: MINUTE 10
beats.line: Minute ten. Your pulse spikes, and you feel jittery.
beats.idea: Close-up of heart beating fast, character trembling.

beats.label: HOUR 2
beats.line: Hour two. Your stomach releases extra acid, causing mild upset.
beats.idea: Stomach shown bubbling, character holding belly.

beats.label: DAY 1
beats.line: Day one. Blood pressure rises, and your heart works harder.
beats.idea: Arm with blood pressure cuff inflating, heart pumping.

beats.label: DAY 3
beats.line: Day three. Cortisol climbs, and you may feel anxious.
beats.idea: Brain with rising cortisol graph, character sweating.

beats.label: WEEK 1
beats.line: Week one. Sleep cycles shift, and you struggle to rest.
beats.idea: Bedroom scene, character tossing, clock showing night.

beats.label: DAY 5
beats.line: Day five. Your teeth may feel more sensitive from acid.
beats.idea: Close-up of teeth with acid droplets, character wincing.

description: A quick look at how ten cups of coffee a day can affect your body.

facts.claim: Caffeine can increase heart rate and cause jitteriness.
facts.source: NIH – National Institute on Drug Abuse

topic: What happens if you drink ten cups of coffee a day?
